title: My Power Level Said Zero.
summary: A young throne-room sweeper touches the Power Stone, and his zero reading climbs past the king to infinity.
frame_0: In a sunlit cream-and-gold throne room, the sweeper touches the fractured black Power Stone beneath infinity. The crowned King and Prince look on from the dais.
camera: Each Testing Day shot uses a locked camera. The cast breathe, blink and react on individual beats.
